title: Puttering Puzzle Cuttlefish
statement: A palm-sized cuttlefish with ruffled apricot fins putters through a tank of midnight-blue slate, honey-lit sand, and smooth porcelain pebbles, rearranging the pebbles with two meticulous arms. Whenever a new arrangement pleases it, a checkerboard ripples across its skin; then it slips beneath its little stone arch, leaving one pebble balanced improbably on another.
